## Purpose

This story is the quiet-window handoff added to epic `0303-692c-55dc-4a18`. It does not define an alternative reclaim. The epic owner executes it in the same window as in-progress story `6981-d937-bce7-4497` (A6-1), using the already-landed A6-0c/A6-0d helpers and every A6-1 safety gate. Its additional responsibility is to execute bug `30d3-eaf0-c7a4-497a` before the history rewrite so the authoritative store is clean before it is repacked.

The primary reclaim is the proven length-aware `git fast-export --no-data | filter | git fast-import` history strip from A6-0c. Repack/gc is follow-on compaction only. Repack alone cannot reclaim the reachable scattered `.bridge_state` history: the measured 12.79 KB/version result was already measured after `--window=250 --depth=50`.

No operational step in this story begins until the operator explicitly confirms zero active sessions plus all `rebar-mcp` servers stopped. Claiming this story after plan-review PASS only reserves the work; it is not permission to mutate the tracker, repair diagnostics, remove pins, rewrite history, or publish.

## Preconditions and ordering

1. Revalidate the A6-1 quiet-window gates immediately after operator confirmation: both GitHub workflows remain disabled; no run is in progress; review-bot `/health` reports `in_flight: 0`; every open current Gerrit patchset has a nonzero current-patchset `LLM-Review` vote from `DETAILED_LABELS`; `refs/reconciler/lock` plus `refs/reconciler/gate` are absent; the AWS timer plus both host LaunchAgents remain paused. If `main` advanced, refresh the host runtime again from current `main`, record its path/version/source SHA, then repeat the exact-runtime epoch-mismatch refusal probe.
2. Converge the shared local tracker only after the quiet-window checks: fetch `origin/tickets`, reset the dedicated tracker to that exact tip, prove the tracker is clean plus zero commits ahead. Do not touch the shared main checkout.
3. Before any store mutation, create a pre-repair off-repo bundle with `infra/scripts/prepare_reclaim_backup.py`; verify it with `git bundle verify`; restore it into a throwaway repository; compare the restored old-tip/pin OIDs to the manifest. Retain this checkpoint until the whole window closes.
4. Claim and execute `30d3-eaf0-c7a4-497a` under its signed plan. Record each diagnostic-class repair, before/after counts, plus the interleave on both tickets. Require `rebar fsck` to report zero repairable diagnostics and exactly the four intentional `STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED` records on `4214-ac28-d19c-41b9`, `72d5-79ec-9e2e-4a2b`, `b043-9490-32ca-4548`, and `fc9e-8c2e-cb2f-465f` before starting the rewrite.
5. Because the repair can advance `origin/tickets`, create a fresh final off-repo bundle at the post-repair tip using new artifact paths. Verify/restore it exactly as above. This final bundle tip must equal the `old-tip` used by the rewrite lease. It is the forward-publication rollback artifact; do not reuse the A6-0d rehearsal artifact.
6. From fresh live ref enumeration, remove only the ref pins documented by A6-0d, and only after the final bundle is verified. Run `infra/scripts/reclaim_bridge_history.py` in a fresh unfiltered clone. The script rewrites to a scratch output ref, dynamically re-adds the current `.bridge_state/` tree, then performs its graph/tree/count/pack-bound assertions; it does not push, repack, or gc. Run operator-controlled `git repack -ad --window=250 --depth=50` followed by `git gc --prune=now` only after both verified off-repo bundles exist. This separate compaction/prune makes the stripped unreachable history release disk bytes.
7. Before publication, require all A6-0c/A6-1 assertions: rewritten `HEAD^{tree}` equals the recorded old-tip tree; commit count is unchanged; merge-commit count is unchanged; `.bridge_state.bak-retarget/` has no residual historical commits; fresh unfiltered clone size is at most 150 MB; pre/post identity-report summary counts match; the multiset of `(event_uuid, verdict, grandfathered)` matches while ignoring rewritten commit SHAs; the synthetic post-rewrite writer leaves old-tip ancestry false plus incremental `size-pack` growth below 1 MB.
8. Re-read the live remote tip immediately before publication. Publish only with exact `--force-with-lease=<old-tip>:<new-tip>`. Any lease failure aborts the publication path and requires a fresh unfiltered clone, new measurements, plus a new final backup for the advanced tip.
9. Verify the published tree/count/size/identity results. Require `git merge-base --is-ancestor <old-tip> origin/tickets` to exit nonzero. Enumerate every ref fetched by a default clone and require none to have the old tip as an ancestor.
10. Converge the persistent review-bot clone over SSM. Land the `rebar.toml` `identity.enforce_since` re-pin through normal Gerrit review using the commit map, with `LLM-Review +1`, `Verified +1`, then Submit.
11. Before allowing the deterministic first post-rewrite write, set `REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_DRAIN=off` in the review-bot execution environment and prove no eligible process can opportunistically drain the inherited enrichment queue. Keep the override active through the first-write fetch, ancestry, and size receipt; record the prior setting for restoration.
12. Use the re-pin review-bot vote as the deterministic first live post-window write. Require it to be the sole writer-produced canonical review-artifact sequence (exactly CREATE, REVIEW_RESULT, code-review-to-work link, and reciprocal work-to-code-review link; no unrelated commit interleaves) between the immediate post-rewrite baseline and the receipt. Record its change/patchset/vote timestamp. Re-fetch `origin/tickets`; require old-tip ancestry to remain false; require growth from the immediate post-rewrite baseline to remain below 1 MB.
13. Restore the prior overlap-drain setting, then re-enable both workflows, the AWS timer, plus both LaunchAgents. Require a green reconciler pass plus final `rebar fsck` with zero repairable diagnostics and exactly the four intentional `STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED` records on `4214-ac28-d19c-41b9`, `72d5-79ec-9e2e-4a2b`, `b043-9490-32ca-4548`, and `fc9e-8c2e-cb2f-465f` before notifying the operator that sessions may resume.

## Rollback

Rollback is an explicit second quiet window. Re-establish every writer pause plus operator confirmation, verify the final off-repo bundle, restore it into a fresh unfiltered clone, then restore the recorded old tip with `--force-with-lease=<rewritten-tip>:<old-tip>`. Revert `rebar.toml` `identity.enforce_since` through normal Gerrit review to the recorded pre-rewrite boundary, then require the old-store identity summary plus `(event_uuid, verdict, grandfathered)` multiset to match the pre-window receipt before writers are enabled. Apply the same temporary `REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_DRAIN=off` guard through the rollback first-write receipt, then restore its prior setting. Re-converge the shared tracker, persistent review-bot clone, plus ephemeral workflow worktrees before re-enabling writers. Never bypass an epoch mismatch inside application merge paths.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] [operator-attested] The operator zero-session/stopped-MCP confirmation is recorded on this ticket before tracker convergence.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The pre-repair bundle passes `git bundle verify`.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The pre-repair bundle restore reproduces every manifest OID.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Ticket `30d3-eaf0-c7a4-497a` closes with a zero-repairable-diagnostic `rebar fsck` receipt plus exactly the four intentional `STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED` records on `4214-ac28-d19c-41b9`, `72d5-79ec-9e2e-4a2b`, `b043-9490-32ca-4548`, and `fc9e-8c2e-cb2f-465f` before rewrite start.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The execution order is recorded on both maintenance tickets.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The final off-repo bundle passes `git bundle verify`.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The final bundle restore reproduces every manifest OID.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The final bundle old tip equals the exact rewrite lease old tip.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Live remote ref enumeration is recorded before pin removal.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Only the A6-0d-documented pre-rewrite pins are removed.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Rewritten `HEAD^{tree}` equals the recorded old-tip tree.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Rewritten commit count equals the pre-rewrite count.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Rewritten merge-commit count equals the pre-rewrite count.
- [ ] [operator-attested] No rewritten commit retains `.bridge_state.bak-retarget/`.
- [ ] [operator-attested] A fresh unfiltered clone of rewritten `tickets` is at most 150 MB.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Pre/post identity-report stderr summary counts are identical.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Pre/post identity-report `(event_uuid, verdict, grandfathered)` multisets are identical when `commit` is ignored.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The synthetic post-rewrite writer leaves old-tip ancestry false.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The synthetic post-rewrite writer increases incremental `size-pack` by less than 1 MB.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The exact `--force-with-lease=<old-tip>:<new-tip>` publication succeeds.
- [ ] [operator-attested] No ref fetched by a default clone has the old tip as an ancestor.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The persistent review-bot clone converges to the published epoch.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Landed `rebar.toml` `identity.enforce_since` equals the mapped post-rewrite SHA.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Opportunistic enrichment is disabled for the deterministic first post-rewrite write and its prior setting is restored after the receipt.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The re-pin review-bot vote is the sole writer-produced canonical review-artifact sequence (exactly CREATE, REVIEW_RESULT, code-review-to-work link, and reciprocal work-to-code-review link; no unrelated commit interleaves) between the immediate post-rewrite baseline and the receipt.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The re-pin review-bot vote leaves old-tip ancestry false.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The re-pin review-bot vote increases post-rewrite `size-pack` by less than 1 MB.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Both reconciler workflows are re-enabled.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The AWS `rebar-autodeploy.timer` is enabled plus active.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Both host LaunchAgents are loaded.
- [ ] [operator-attested] A post-enable reconciler pass completes green.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Final `rebar fsck` reports zero repairable diagnostics and exactly the four intentional `STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED` records on `4214-ac28-d19c-41b9`, `72d5-79ec-9e2e-4a2b`, `b043-9490-32ca-4548`, and `fc9e-8c2e-cb2f-465f`.

## Evidence and scope

Record command exits, exact SHAs, bundle paths/checksums/sizes, before/after pack bytes, run/SSM/Gerrit identifiers, timestamps, plus the actual interleave on this ticket and on A6-1 where the evidence is shared. Operational scope uses `infra/scripts/prepare_reclaim_backup.py` plus `infra/scripts/reclaim_bridge_history.py`; the only repository file changed during the window is `rebar.toml` for the normal Gerrit re-pin. No `src/` change belongs to this story.
